definitions.explanation: The position lower than something else or the lower surface of something.
Can indicate someone younger or lower in status.

examples.english: The cat is under the chair.

examples.japanese: {下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: The book is under the desk.
There is a river under the bridge.
I didn't have an umbrella, so I waited under a tree for the rain to stop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧{下|した}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My younger brother is two years younger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{三|さん}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧{下|した}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My younger sister is three years younger than me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{下|した}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: She is one year younger than me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{下|した}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えます→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: At work, you teach the job to people below you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|した}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are three people below me who joined recently.

notes:
{下|した} indicates a position below something, or can refer to being younger or lower in rank/status.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|した}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: under ~, below ~
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|した}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: under (authority/supervision of)
- ⟦{年下|としした}→年下：07303_toshishita⟧: younger person

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧: underground, basement
- ⟦{下着|したぎ}→下着：01605_shitagi⟧: underwear
- ⟦{下手|へた}→下手：00703_heta⟧: unskillful, poor at
- ⟦{目下|めした}→目下：08808_meshita⟧: subordinate, junior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下|した}: below, under (opposite: ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧)
- ⟦{下|しも}→下：noentry⟧: downstream, lower part (in compounds)

USAGE FOR AGE:
〜つ{下|した} indicates how many years younger: ⟦{三|さん}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧{下|した} = three years younger.
